messages:
jen: Hey team — customer (Acme Mobile) reporting repeated mid-stream disconnects. Starts streaming completion, gets a partial JSON chunk, then connection closes when they toggle from carrier to phone hotspot. They attached a pcap and app logs. :frowning:

alex: Thanks. Do we have the connection_id + client sdk version? Any server error (502/503) in our logs?

jen: connection_id=0x5f3a9b, sdk=mobile-js/1.2.4, platform=Android 12. Server logs show normal 200 streaming until abrupt EOF, no 5xx. TCP shows immediate RST from client side. pcap snippet below:
```
14:22:10.123 IP 10.0.0.5.52344 > 34.201.12.7.443: Flags [P.], seq 345:789, ack 1024, win 64240
14:22:10.124 IP 34.201.12.7.443 > 10.0.0.5.52344: Flags [.], ack 789, win 65535
14:22:10.300 IP 10.0.0.5.52344 > 34.201.12.7.443: Flags [R], seq 790, win 0
```

maria: That looks like client-side RST on IP change. We saw a similar pattern in an internal flaky-hotspot test where the OS aggressively reset sockets on interface changes. Repro steps I used:
1) Start stream on carrier (cell).
2) Turn on phone hotspot and connect another device to it.
3) Toggle app to background then foreground quickly.
Result: RST within ~200-400ms of interface change.

ryan: Network/devops note: When mobile toggles interfaces, the TCP stack usually can't keep the 5-tuple so client ends up resetting. From infra side, our keepalive is 15s, token TTL is 60s. But a client-initiated RST is definitive — server can't keep sending. No 503 from our side. :eyes:

alex: Two possibilities we should triage: (A) client SDK is performing token refresh that closes socket during IP swap (we had a known bug in 1.2.4 where refresh triggers socket close); (B) OS-level aggressive reset as Maria suggests. Need to confirm by reproducing with SDK patched to avoid closing socket during refresh.

jen: Customer says their app does a token refresh on network change (app-level). They forwarded logs showing refresh start at 14:22:10.290 and RST at 14:22:10.300.

maria: I can reproduce on Android emulator. Quick repro (adb):
1) Start app and begin streaming: `adb shell am start -n com.acme/.MainActivity`
2) `adb shell svc wifi disable` (forces carrier)
3) `adb shell svc wifi enable` then toggle hotspot clients
I saw same RST in ~80% runs.

alex: Action items: I'll push a small SDK patch that defers socket close until a grace window (2000ms) after a token refresh when a network change flag is present. Also add a client-side keepalive ping immediately after reconnect to resume prefix.

ryan: On server side, we can add a short rejoin window to accept a resume token for 10s after a midstream disconnect (if session id matches) and wire that into the routing layer so KV cache isn't lost immediately. I'll open infra ticket INC-2314.

natalie: Customer is asking about billing for these partial streams — are they charged for partial tokens?

alex: Policy: streaming tokens that were successfully emitted count toward usage. If the connection aborted mid-token we bill for delivered tokens. We should escalate to billing team if customer wants a credit.

natalie: Okay I'll draft a goodwill credit offer template for cases where RSTs are due to OS-level toggle and can't be addressed from our side immediately.

jen: Temporary workaround shared with customer: set SDK keepalive interval to 10s, enable automatic reconnect with resume token, and apply the 1.2.5 patch when available. They want repro steps to trial that internally.

maria: Repro checklist I posted (short):
- Device: Android 11/12, reproduce with emulator and physical device.
- Start stream while on cell, then initiate hotspot and toggle WiFi.
- Observe pcap for client RST; check app logs for token refresh timing.
- Try with SDK build that defers socket close.

alex: I'll attach a CI build (mobile-js/1.2.5-rc1) to this thread when ready and link the PR. deploy-bot will post deploy status.

deploy-bot: build mobile-js/1.2.5-rc1 uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.net/mobile-js/1.2.5-rc1 (sha256: abcd1234)

ryan: I've created INC-2314 and assigned to eng-infra. Adding metric: midstream_client_rst_count by region.

jen: Thanks everyone — I'll send the workaround and timeline to the customer and ask for the pcap if they try the RC. :thumbsup:
